# EvidenceCheck

EvidenceCheck is an evidence-first vendor due-diligence service for procurement, third-party risk, security/compliance teams and AI agents.

## Primary capabilities
- /web-extract — clean public webpage extraction
- /site-audit — public website security preflight
- /vendor-preflight — vendor evidence, gaps and supplier questions
- /analyze — business-document analysis
- /review-purchase — fixed-scope human-led vendor review

## Machine interfaces
- /openapi.json
- /skill.md
- /basedagents.json
- /demo

## Payment
Paid machine endpoints use x402 with USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). Prices are published by the service.

## Trust boundary
Outputs are first-pass evidence and signals. They are not certification, a penetration test, a legal opinion, or proof that a vendor is secure/compliant. Material findings require appropriate human verification.

## Commercial intent
The product is designed to reduce repetitive first-pass vendor research and turn missing evidence into concrete next actions.
